cat > .tmp_recs.sql <<'EOF'
WITH scored AS (
  SELECT u.user_id, i.item_id,
    (u.e1*i.e1 + u.e2*i.e2 + u.e3*i.e3 + u.e4*i.e4 +
     u.e5*i.e5 + u.e6*i.e6 + u.e7*i.e7 + u.e8*i.e8) AS score
  FROM user_embeddings_raw_1 u
  CROSS JOIN item_embeddings_raw_1 i
  WHERE NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM interactions_raw_1 x
    WHERE x.user_id = u.user_id AND x.item_id = i.item_id
  )
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT user_id, item_id, score,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY user_id ORDER BY score DESC, item_id ASC) AS rnk
  FROM scored
)
SELECT user_id || '#' || CAST(rnk AS VARCHAR) AS rec_id,
       user_id, rnk AS rank, item_id
FROM ranked
WHERE rnk <= 5
ORDER BY user_id, rank
EOF
mkdir -p .tmp
hops sql --no-verify --catalog delta --schema mlpab8dd319_featurestore -f .tmp_recs.sql --limit 0 --json 2>&1 | grep -v -E "INFO:|UserWarning|pip install|To ensure|Base URL|Logged in|explore" > .tmp/recs.json
head -c 600 .tmp/recs.json; echo; echo "..."; python3 -c "import json;d=json.load(open('.tmp/recs.json'));print('ROWS',len(d));print('users',len(set(r['user_id'] for r in d)))" 2>/dev/null || grep -c rec_id .tmp/recs.json
